newsitem.title: USA: National TeamTech inks new service pact.
newsitem.headline: National TeamTech inks new service pact.

text.p: National TeamTech Inc said Friday it signed an agreement to provide help desk and customer support to Long Distance of Michigan customers.
Financial terms were not announced, but National TeamTech said the deal is expected to contribute to its revenues and earnings in the second quarter of 1997.
National TeamTech is a provider of information technology support services to corporations, government agencies and service organizations.
Its shares were up 1/2 Friday at 17-1/2.
